Name: Zichri, Man of Ephraim
Summary: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king's son, Azrikam and Elkanah in Pekah's invasion of Judah.
KeyStory: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew the king's son and two of Ahaz's chief officers.
RelatedPeople: Ahaz, King of Judah; Maaseiah, Son of Ahaz
LifeLesson: Might used against brethren is recorded as slaughter, not glory.
